name: BackendBench
intro: BackendBench 是 Meta PyTorch 发布的开放评测套件，用于衡量模型或人类能否为 PyTorch 算子编写正确且高效的后端实现。它用 OpInfo 边界样例验证正确性，并用真实 Hugging Face 模型追踪得到的 TorchBench 张量形状评估性能。
build_method: OpInfo边界用例与真实模型张量追踪, 统一算子映射, 多测试套件执行验证
metric: Operator Correctness Pass Rate, Geometric Mean Speedup, Perf@p
task_type: 后端实现, 代码生成
eval_feature: 先正确性后性能, PyTorch eager参考实现, 真实模型形状, 全算子通过判定
scale: 271个OpInfo正确性算子, 124个性能算子; 平均13个OpInfo与110个TorchBench测试/算子
build_method_en: OpInfo edge cases and real-model tensor traces, unified operator mapping, multi-suite execution validation
eval_feature_en: Correctness before performance, PyTorch eager reference, real-model shapes, all-tests operator verdict
intro_en: BackendBench is an open Meta PyTorch evaluation suite for measuring whether models or humans can implement correct and fast PyTorch operator backends. It validates correctness with OpInfo edge cases and measures performance on TorchBench tensor shapes traced from real Hugging Face models.
scale_en: 271 OpInfo correctness operators, 124 performance operators; averages of 13 OpInfo and 110 TorchBench tests per operator
metric_en: Operator Correctness Pass Rate, Geometric Mean Speedup, Perf@p
drawio_review_note: BackendBench has no standalone benchmark paper. The diagram is aligned to the official Meta PyTorch repository, README, docs/correctness.md, and executable suite structure. It preserves the 271-operator OpInfo correctness set, 124-operator performance set, real Hugging Face model tensor traces, OpInfo edge cases, op_map alias coverage, torch.library dispatch, smoke/OpInfo/TorchBench/Facto suites, PyTorch-reference comparison with equal_nan and 1e-2 tolerances, all-tests operator verdict, synchronized do_bench timing, correctness-gated performance, geometric-mean speedup, and Perf@p reporting.
